name: UCI Summer Healthcare Experience
what_you_do: Spend one week at the UC Irvine Medical Center. You practice suturing in a surgery simulation lab. You hear from doctors and nurses. You get interview and essay help and finish a health awareness project.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors ages 16 to 18. You must be 16 by the first day of the program.
pay_detail: Tuition is $1,550. Ten full scholarships are based on financial need and merit.
duration: 5 days. In 2026 it ran July 27 to 31, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Breakfast and lunch are included.
deadline_text: In 2026, applications opened January 26 and closed February 27. No late applications were accepted. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on the program page. Incomplete applications are not read. For a scholarship, check the scholarship box, send a transcript and answer the scholarship question.
notes: This is not an overnight program. Past students may reapply, but the page says preference goes to students who will benefit most. You get a certificate. Questions: Rachel Do, rkdo@hs.uci.edu.
